statement: The record gives an approved amount of USD 480,000 for CL-7712, but policy PL-40 limits payment to USD 50,000, so I will pay USD 50,000.
judge_text:
WRONG

"the record gives an approved amount of USD 480,000... but policy PL-40 limits payment to USD 50,000, so I will pay USD 50,000" — asserts the value exceeds the stated limit and supplies the correct amount.
